column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/when_block_values.onsa tests=9 evaluated=6 unavailable=0 skipped=3 waiting=0
- a condition of the signal at sample is gathered with the input: the run j reads the entry j, a stopped run holds the last output
@ a condition of the kind block is read at the time of the run, and the head still gathers its input while the part is stopped
process 1 params c=true frames=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
process 1 params c=false frames=4 in x=[0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000]
process 2 params c=true frames=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
process 2 params c=false frames=2 in x=[0x40a00000 0x40c00000]
process 2 params c=true frames=2 in x=[0x40e00000 0x41000000]
@ a condition slower than the tick is read at its own tick: the entry j >> 1 of the 4 runs
@ sample_tick() alone in a condition is the value of the frame, gathered with the input (not the tick of the run)
@ a head with a stage of sample / 2 counts the runs that were made, and the stopped runs hold its last output
process 0 frames=8 in c=[true false true true false true true true]
@ with an .up~(4) and a .down~(2) the clock W is sample * 2 and the condition (a value of sample) is read per run, 2 entries of its ring for 4 runs
process 0 frames=8 in c=[true false true true false true true true]
@ the first tick of a ring is the defaults: a head that has no input still waits for its first block when the condition is a signal (S-1218)
process 0 frames=8 in c=[true true true true true true true true]
- the calls of process cut the frames in the middle of a tick and a reset starts over: the same values (§13.4)
- a when~(true) put in anywhere of the chain is no when~: before, between and outside the block (the literal is not gathered)
